name: notion-mention-link

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the loaded preview card with the mountain image, title, description and domain.

tagline: Hover a page link to pop open a card with image, blurb and domain.
summary: A Notion-style inline mention of a web page, shown with a tiny favicon and the page title. Hovering it brings up a card with the page's image, summary and domain without leaving the document.
appearance: Body text in a document with an inline chip made of a small square favicon, a grey site name and an underlined bold page title. On hover a rounded card drops below holding a mountain photo, a heading, a short paragraph and the domain.
behaviour: Hovering or focusing the link waits a moment, then shows a loading skeleton that settles into the preview card; leaving closes it shortly after. Details can be fetched and cached on mount or on first hover.
demo_content: Trip planning notes mentioning an Alpine Guide article, Five days in the Dolomites, with a mountain photo.
search_phrases: clickable mention of a web page
use_when: Long documents cite other pages and readers should glimpse the target without leaving the text.
avoid_when: It relies on a server endpoint for page metadata; without one you must pass the metadata yourself.
customise: Pass the url plus optional metadata (title, description, image, site, domain) and the preview width and height; the fetch endpoint and delays are props too.
weight_why: A link and a hover card; the only work is one cached metadata fetch.

a11y.note: The preview opens on hover or focus, but its slide and fade have no reduced-motion fallback.

issues: Frames 3 and 4 show the preview with an empty grey image area while it loads, which reads as missing content.
The preview card covers the paragraph under the mention, hiding text while it is open.
polish_why: Crisp inline mention and a tidy preview card; the empty loading image and overlap are rough spots.
title: Notion Mention Link
